periods.summary: Or-Gaule appears with John and Lunaeyes above Caldia, presenting the legal claim that Quedland and Vermillion have agreed to a League-style representative war. He uses John as a puppet mouthpiece, then openly admits he wants to avoid League interference because it would spoil his play with Stella. He placates Naseem by allowing League members already in Vermillion to join the roster and uses Quedland citizens as leverage to make Nene accept the arrangement. He releases Lunaeyes, withdraws healthy soldiers, orders Ein away from the palace, and sets conditions: a five-person battle royale in Quedland's capital with Stella as a mandatory Vermillion participant. Later discussion implies Lunaeyes paid him a terrible private price beyond ordinary advantage.

key_events.summary: Announces and exploits the representative-war framework with Lunaeyes and John.
Sets Quedland's roster and demands Stella's participation.
His sister's Bloody Cross testimony defines his true nature.
